bug_semantics: Authenticated tenant users could supply or enumerate another tenant's numeric contact identifier. POST /contact/save passed that identifier into an unscoped Contact::find(...) update and overwrote the selected record, while GET /contact/export-vcard/{id} used unscoped Contact::findOrFail(...) and returned its PII as a vCard. Equivalent supplier-contact save and export paths had the same missing company_id constraint.
flaw_origin: The earliest real first-writer is 266c2bec31a4ef56431f0ee9ed4dfadfa12661b9: it created the authenticated ContactSaveController and /contact/save route with an attacker-controlled update branch using Contact::find($request->id) and no ownership check. Commit 65f6b9f961efe533b4d3f20f1eddad132fe8ef1d only moved that already-vulnerable logic into ContactRepository and is not the BIC. The read/export surface was added later by a0306e77f95aaf57afec25ef74e4aa2da275c830, and 8641cb87a5db9ac99b755510374bb8a37a0a67e2 later added the equivalent supplier save/export surfaces.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. `git cat-file commit 266c2bec31a4ef56431f0ee9ed4dfadfa12661b9` shows author and committer Gustavo Novaro <gnovaro@gmail.com> and only the message `Lead -> Contact save. Clean code remove unused controller. Improve import lead phone clean data`; it contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI trailer, or bot identity.
evidence: CNA record https://secur0.com/en/cna/cve-list/cve-2026-19433-idor-in-prospero-flow-crm-contact-save-and-vcard-export identifies the authenticated POST /contact/save and GET /contact/export-vcard/{id} IDORs, Prospero Flow CRM before 5.4.8, and direct patch f16b4af2. In the validated clone, `git show f36c2a115f4c28c82181f1798c01582ae953b932:app/Repositories/ContactRepository.php` shows pre-fix `$contact = Contact::find($data['id']);`; the two pre-fix ContactExportVCard files use Contact::findOrFail($id) and SupplierContact::findOrFail($id), and SupplierContactRepository uses SupplierContact::find($data['id']). `git grep -n -E 'ContactSaveController|ContactExportVCard' f36c2a115f4c28c82181f1798c01582ae953b932 -- routes` reproduces all four reachable routes. Each affected controller extends MainController, whose constructor applies `auth`, establishing a low-privilege authenticated attack path. `git show f16b4af2027b17bef7c604c92dbd86cf38082398` replaces all four ID-only lookups with id plus `Auth::user()->company_id` queries and adds cross-tenant tests; its sole parent is f36c2a115f4c28c82181f1798c01582ae953b932, so it is the direct closing fix. For provenance, `git log --reverse -S'Contact::find($request->id)' -- app/Http/Controllers/Contact/ContactSaveController.php` and `git log -L 22,22:app/Http/Controllers/Contact/ContactSaveController.php 944a9a22bb4bb82f52f3257a0b27f6d16f29d73a` both terminate at 266c2bec31a4ef56431f0ee9ed4dfadfa12661b9. `git show 266c2bec31a4ef56431f0ee9ed4dfadfa12661b9` shows that commit adding the controller, route, and unscoped update branch. Direct-parent comparison `git diff --name-status f84405497c20f4744b3ce55c847a122d9a77326d 266c2bec31a4ef56431f0ee9ed4dfadfa12661b9 -- app/Http/Controllers/Contact/ContactSaveController.php routes/web.php` reports the controller as newly added, and `git grep -n 'ContactSaveController\|/contact/save' f84405497c20f4744b3ce55c847a122d9a77326d -- app routes` has no match, directly proving parent absence. Continuing history shows 65f6b9f961efe533b4d3f20f1eddad132fe8ef1d as the repository refactor, a0306e77f95aaf57afec25ef74e4aa2da275c830 as the customer vCard first-writer, and 8641cb87a5db9ac99b755510374bb8a37a0a67e2 as the supplier first-writer. For versions, f36c2a115f4c28c82181f1798c01582ae953b932 and f16b4af2027b17bef7c604c92dbd86cf38082398 both contain APP_VERSION 5.4.7; immediately following 361566c1ddb01df16f2cff0aa836f04be174f3c4 bumps it to 5.4.8. `git tag --contains f16b4af2027b17bef7c604c92dbd86cf38082398 --sort=version:refname` begins with v5.5.3 because 5.4.8 was untagged, while `git tag --contains 266c2bec31a4ef56431f0ee9ed4dfadfa12661b9` includes vulnerable v1.0.0, v2.0.1, and v4.6.0. Finally, the BIC-only `git cat-file commit 266c2bec31a4ef56431f0ee9ed4dfadfa12661b9` check has no AI marker.
reasoning: The vulnerability begins when the authenticated save route first accepts a caller-controlled existing contact id and resolves it without deriving or checking tenant ownership. That happened in 266c2bec31a4ef56431f0ee9ed4dfadfa12661b9; although contacts did not yet have a direct company_id column, they belonged to tenant-owned leads/customers, so arbitrary-id overwrite was already cross-tenant. The later 65f6b9f9 repository commit preserves and relocates the same lookup, so treating it as the introducer would violate the protocol's no-move/no-refactor rule. Later commits expand the same authorization failure to vCard export and supplier contacts but do not move the lifecycle's earliest boundary. The direct fix consistently binds every affected lookup to the authenticated company, and the immediately following version bump establishes 5.4.8 as the first fixed version. Because the actual BIC commit object has a human identity and no AI marker, later AI evidence on the 2026 fix/version commits is out of scope; the required BIC-only classification is NOT_AI.
